scientific_integrity: Exact finite coefficient/orbit enumeration, double-cover and genus-one geometry, and independent Groebner-basis and automorphism checks. Reproducible scripts and full orbit table are included; no claim of independent peer review.
scientific_limitations: Complete ambient orbit classification only for geometrically smooth (2,2) divisors on the split quadric over F3. Does not address arbitrary QRT pencils, non-split quadrics, singular curves, larger fields or unmarked elliptic isomorphism. Priority risk from possible unindexed finite-field tables remains.
title: A ternary atlas of elliptic biquadratics, branch pairs and QRT periods
